evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/lib/queryKeys.ts:347 — AUTHED_QUERY_KEY_ROOTS is the allow-list logout() iterates to purge session-scoped TanStack Query subtrees (contexts/AuthContext.tsx:553-555: `for (const root of AUTHED_QUERY_KEY_ROOTS) queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: [root] })`). Its own doc (AuthContext logout, issue #712) states the goal is that 'user-bound data never leaks into the next session'. Any query-key root NOT in this list is NOT purged on logout.

Three feature hooks define their own local key factory whose root string is missing from AUTHED_QUERY_KEY_ROOTS: features/predictive-maintenance/hooks/usePredictiveMaintenance.ts (`predictiveKeys.all = ['predictive-maintenance']`), features/sentiment (`all: ['sentiment']`), features/notification-analytics (`all: ['notification-analytics']`). Static diff: roots defined by feature *Keys factories = {ai-chat, notification-analytics, predictive-maintenance, sentiment}; only 'ai-chat' is present in the allow-list — the other three were forgotten when their pages were routed (gap-sweep, Epic 13 / Story 2B-C.3).

All three are tenant-scoped: predictive-maintenance equipment/prediction lists (`GET /ai/equipment`), sentiment analytics, and notification delivery analytics. All three pages are routed and reachable (routes/lazyRoutes.tsx:317 SentimentDashboardPage, :322 NotificationAnalyticsPage, :336 PredictiveMaintenancePage). ppt-web is an SPA — logout does NOT reload the page, so queryClient persists across logout->next-login. On a shared manager/kiosk workstation, user B navigating to any of these three pages after user A logged out can see user A's cached data until the 5-min staleTime lapses or a refetch completes.

Fix: add 'predictive-maintenance', 'sentiment', 'notification-analytics' to AUTHED_QUERY_KEY_ROOTS (queryKeys.ts:347). Better: add a CI/lint or unit assertion that every feature-local *Keys.all root is a member of AUTHED_QUERY_KEY_ROOTS so future gap-sweep pages can't silently reintroduce the leak. Distinct from all prior ppt-web-core findings (none touched the logout purge list).

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/App.tsx:229-231 — the entire lazily-loaded route table renders inside `<main><Suspense fallback={<RouteLoading/>}><AppRoutes/></Suspense></main>` with NO React error boundary at the route-outlet level. The ONLY ErrorBoundary in the app is at the root (main.tsx:50, wrapping the whole `<App/>` — every provider, AppNavigation, and the outlet).

routes/lazyRoutes.tsx defines ~90 `lazy(() => import(...))` page chunks (all feature pages). A rejected dynamic import is NOT caught by Suspense — it propagates as a thrown error. After a redeploy, a user holding a stale index.html requests an old hashed chunk that no longer exists on the CDN (404) — a routine production event for a Vite hashed-chunk SPA. That rejection, or any render-time throw inside a page, bubbles to the ROOT boundary and unmounts the entire application shell (nav + layout + providers UI), replacing everything with the global fallback.

components/ErrorBoundary.tsx:99 handleRetry only resets `hasError` and re-renders the same children — for a failed `lazy()` import the browser has permanently cached the rejected module promise, so 'Try Again' re-throws immediately; only the full 'Reload Page' path (window.location.reload, :182) recovers. Net effect: a single failed page chunk or one buggy page component takes down the whole shell with no in-place recovery.

Fix: wrap `<Suspense><AppRoutes/></Suspense>` in App.tsx:229 with a route-scoped `<ErrorBoundary>` (the component already supports a custom `fallback`) so failures are contained to the `<main>` outlet, keeping AppNavigation/shell mounted and letting the user navigate away or retry a single route. Optionally give the route-level boundary chunk-load-error detection that triggers an automatic one-shot reload. Prior 2026-07-24 ppt-web-core note recorded 'ErrorBoundary present' as a positive but did not examine its placement/granularity — this is a new finding.
